records.jp: ほ、本気！？<CR>星崎さん、それOKしたの！？
records.en_original: Are you serious?! And you agreed, Hoshizaki?!
records.en_auxiliary: Are you serious?! And you agreed, Hoshizaki?!
records.en: Are you serious?! And you agreed, Hoshizaki-san?!

records.jp: あー、えっと……<CR>みんなに相談したら反対されると思って……
records.en_original: Well, uh... I figured that if I asked you all about it, you'd try to talk me out of it...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, uh... I figured that if I asked you all about it, you'd try to talk me out of it...
records.en: Well, uh... I figured that if I asked you all about it, you'd try to talk me out of it...

records.jp: 勝手に話を進めて、ごめん……
records.en_original: Sorry to have kept you out of the loop...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry to have kept you out of the loop...
records.en: Sorry to have kept you out of the loop...

records.jp: ユズさん、大丈夫なんだよね……？
records.en_original: You can do it, right Yuzu...?
records.en_auxiliary: You can do it, right Yuzu...?
records.en: You can do it, right Yuzu-san...?

records.jp: ……信じてもらうしかないね
records.en_original: You'll just have to trust us.
records.en_auxiliary: You'll just have to trust us.
records.en: You'll just have to trust us.

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao-chan...

records.jp: 私……リフレクターとして、<CR>ちゃんと言っておかないといけないと思う
records.en_original: As a Reflector...there's something I think you need to know.
records.en_auxiliary: As a Reflector...there's something I think you need to know.
records.en: As a Reflector...there's something I think you need to know.

records.jp: 私は、想いを抜かれた人をたくさん見てきた。<CR>それの結果どうなってしまうのかも、よく知ってる
records.en_original: I've seen many people who've had their emotions extracted. I know all too well the effects it can have.
records.en_auxiliary: I've seen many people who've had their emotions extracted. I know all too well the effects it can have.
records.en: I've seen many people who've had their emotions extracted. I know all too well the effects it can have.

records.jp: 本当に危ないことをしようとしてる。<CR>それでも、やるんだね？
records.en_original: What you're going to do is really dangerous. Are you sure about this?
records.en_auxiliary: What you're going to do is really dangerous. Are you sure about this?
records.en: What you're going to do is really dangerous. Are you sure about this?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: ……分かった。愛央ちゃんがそう言うなら
records.en_original: Okay... If you say so.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay... If you say so.
records.en: ...All right. If you say so, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ユズ、ライム。やるからには、勝算があるのよね？
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime. If you're going to do this, that means there's a chance of success, correct?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime. If you're going to do this, that means there's a chance of success, correct?
records.en: Yuzu, Lime. If you're going to do this, that means there's a chance of success, correct?

records.jp: ……ある。でも、<CR>それはみんなにかかってる
records.en_original: There is...but it will depend on all of us.
records.en_auxiliary: There is...but it will depend on all of us.
records.en: There is...but it will depend on all of us.

records.jp: 私たち……？
records.en_original: All of us...?
records.en_auxiliary: All of us...?
records.en: All of us...?

records.jp: みんなの、愛央ちゃんへの想いの大きさ
records.en_original: And how strong our feelings toward Ao are.
records.en_auxiliary: And how strong our feelings toward Ao are.
records.en: And how strong our feelings toward Ao-chan are.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの心からフラグメントが抜けている間、<CR>心をつなぎとめるのはみんなの想い
records.en_original: After the Fragment is extracted from Ao's heart, it will be everyone's emotions that hold it together.
records.en_auxiliary: After the Fragment is extracted from Ao's heart, it will be everyone's emotions that hold it together.
records.en: After the Fragment is extracted from Ao-chan's heart, it will be everyone's emotions that hold it together.

records.jp: もしこれが足りなければ……心の糸が切れて、<CR>愛央ちゃんは二度と目を覚まさない
records.en_original: If it's not enough, her heart's thread will be severed, and Ao will never wake up.
records.en_auxiliary: If it's not enough, her heart's thread will be severed, and Ao will never wake up.
records.en: If it's not enough, her heart's thread will be severed, and Ao-chan will never wake up.

records.jp: あー、怖いなー。みんなが私のこと<CR>信じてくれなかったら、死んじゃうかもなー
records.en_original: Oh, how scary! If you all don't believe in me, I might die!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, how scary! If you all don't believe in me, I might die!
records.en: Oh, how scary! If you all don't believe in me, I might die!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao.
records.en: Ao-chan.

records.jp: 心外だよ
records.en_original: How could you.
records.en_auxiliary: How could you.
records.en: How could you.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんへの想いが、その程度だと思われてるなんて
records.en_original: I thought you'd know how strong my feelings are.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you'd know how strong my feelings are.
records.en: I can't believe you think my feelings for Ao-chan are that shallow.

records.jp: よく言ったこころ！<CR>そうだぞ！　あんまりあたしたちを舐めるな！
records.en_original: That's right! Don't underestimate us!
records.en_auxiliary: That's right! Don't underestimate us!
records.en: That's right! Don't underestimate us!

records.jp: ……ふふっ、分かってる。そう言ってくれると思ってた
records.en_original: Hehe... I know. I thought you'd say that.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... I know. I thought you'd say that.
records.en: Hehe... I know. I thought you'd say that.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ユズ、ライム。私たちは想いを託すことしかできない。<CR>だから……頼んだよ、愛央のこと
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime, you're the only ones we can entrust our feelings to so...we're counting on you to take care of Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime, you're the only ones we can entrust our feelings to so...we're counting on you to take care of Ao.
records.en: Yuzu, Lime, you're the only ones we can entrust our feelings to so...we're counting on you to take care of Ao.

records.jp: 任せて、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Leave it to us, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Leave it to us, Hina.
records.en: Leave it to us, Hina-chan.

records.jp: 正直言えば、怖いです。<CR>でも……もっと怖いのは、星崎さんのはず
records.en_original: Honestly, I'm scared. But I'm sure it's nothing compared to what Ao is feeling.
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I'm scared. But I'm sure it's nothing compared to what Ao is feeling.
records.en: Honestly, I'm scared. But I'm sure it's nothing compared to what Hoshizaki-san is feeling.

records.jp: わたしは、わたしにやれる限りのことをします。<CR>星崎さんの決意を無駄にしたくない
records.en_original: I'll do whatever it is I can. I don't want to let Ao's resolve go to waste.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll do whatever it is I can. I don't want to let Ao's resolve go to waste.
records.en: I'll do whatever it is I can. I don't want to let Hoshizaki-san's resolve go to waste.

records.jp: 私にも、何かできるでしょうか……
records.en_original: Is there anything I can do to help...?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything I can do to help...?
records.en: Is there anything I can do to help...?

records.jp: ……できる。人を信じる心に貴賤はない
records.en_original: Yes. We have no reason not to trust you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. We have no reason not to trust you.
records.en: Yes. We have no reason not to trust you.

records.jp: ……はい。ありがとうございます、久野さん
records.en_original: Thank you, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Kirara.
records.en: Thank you, Kuno-san.

records.jp: ユズたちも、覚悟を決めよう
records.en_original: We're determined to make this work.
records.en_auxiliary: We're determined to make this work.
records.en: Yuzu and the others should prepare themselves too.

records.jp: 移動しよう。ユズとライムのココロトープに
records.en_original: Let's make our way to our Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's make our way to our Heartscape.
records.en: Let's go to Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.
